Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/resource_contracts.py

src/agent_runtime/resource_contracts.py

Python · Tier A

Describe resource CRUD/action coverage with exact existing tool bindings. coverage validates ownership and bound argument schemas, exposes missing classifications and preserves delegated operations; discovery_resources limits visible bindings to accepted capabilities. These descriptions neither dispatch a tool nor grant permission, and unsupported/not-applicable cases retain explicit reasons.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ResourceOperation 20 One supported binding, explicit delegation, limitation, or implementation gap.
ResourceOperation.valid_binding 33 Require an exact tool ID for supported/delegated resource actions. Unbound classifications must instead carry a reason and cannot smuggle tool arguments or an executable binding.
SkillResourceDefinition 42 CRUD applies to resources, not indiscriminately to every tool or skill.
SkillResourceDefinition.complete_classification 57 Require all five CRUD keys for each resource and keep additional lifecycle actions from shadowing create/list/read/update/delete. Availability and authorization remain separate runtime checks.
coverage 65 Return bounded per-resource coverage and validate every executable reference.
discovery_resources 128 Project bindings only when their tools are inside the accepted execution scope.
